name: Bloodbound Curse-Warden
subtitle: Medium Construct, Neutral
immune: lightning, poison, bludgeoning, slashing, piercing (from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine)
conditionImmune: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Cursed Touch
traits.entries: When the creature hits a target with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be cursed for 1 minute. While cursed, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.entries: When the Curse-Warden starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, it goes berserk. While berserk, it attacks the nearest creature it can see, friend or foe. If no creature is in reach, it attacks the nearest object instead. The Curse-Warden remains berserk until it is destroyed or fully repaired. Its creator can attempt to calm it with a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check if within 60 feet and audible to the construct.

traits.name: Aversion of Fire
traits.entries: If the tomb guardian takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.entries: The tomb guardian is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.entries: Whenever the tomb guardian is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.entries: The tomb guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.entries: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.entries: The tomb guardian makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
